# Volatile Nuka Quantum

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Dec 3, 2025
- 2 min read

Updated: Dec 12, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_fd521ec170a74cf0b1a0aeec70eed82b~mv2.jpg)

*****Subject to change pending porting to live servers*****

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_57f96805db004ea1bedbabbaef3dffa6~mv2.jpg)

A refreshing ice cold bottle of Nuka-Cola Quantum gifted from the Nuka-Queen. Drink it quickly, or there will be consequences.

**Buff**

+100 Action Points (AP) refill

**Consequences**

If you don’t drink it in time, you are hit with a freezing effect that slows you and drains your Action Points, and the Quantum disappears from your inventory.

**Cola Nut Perk Card**

| **Perk Rank** | **Thirst Bar Refill** | **Healing** | **Action Points Restored** | 
| None | 540 | 20 over 10s | 100 AP | 
| Rank 1 | 810 | 30 over 10s | 150 AP | 
| Rank 2 | 1080 | 40 over 10s | 200 AP | 
| Rank 3 | 1350 | 50 over 10s | 250 AP | 

**Glowing Gut Perk Card**

| **Perk Rank** | **Total Rads** | 
| None | 10 Rads | 
| Rank 1 | 20 Rads | 
| Rank 2 | 30 Rads | 
| Rank 3 | 40 Rads | 

**Spoil Rate**

None

**Weight**

0 pounds

**How to obtain**

If you encounter **Anna the Nuka-Queen** during a Head Hunt, she throws Nuka-Quantum grenades.

If one of her grenades hits you, the drink appears in your inventory.

**Recipe**

None

**Workbench**

None

**Stacking**

Classed as a Nuka-Cola drink, so it stacks with other buffs and mods, but does not stack on itself.
